title: Forward Guidance: Oil Shock at the Recession Precipice

excerpts.label: Stairstep walkdown — tacos don't work on physical assets
excerpts.insight: The market is in the most obvious stairstep walkdown possible. Unlike tariffs, a physical commodity shock involving Iran can't be reversed by tweet.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: SHORT equities via spot (not puts). This is a one-way bleed — 1.5%/day on indices. Vol too elevated for puts to pay. Use futures or spot shorts in software/consumer discretionary.

excerpts.label: Europe & Asia most exposed — dollar long is the trade
excerpts.insight: Strait of Hormuz closure acutely hits Europe and Asia. US is energy independent with export ban optionality. The euro is pricing in a rate hike — the most absurd thing possible.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: LONG USD / SHORT EUR. Crowded dollar short + European energy shock + ECB rate hike priced in = violent re-pricing ahead. EUR/USD short is highest-conviction FX trade right now.

excerpts.label: Violent dollar rally — gold caught in the crossfire
excerpts.insight: Near-term, gold gets caught up in the dollar rally even though medium-term the gold bull thesis is intact. Initial shock = dollar up, gold down.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: FADE gold near-term — dollar rally will pressure it. Reload on dips medium-term: Fed QE at $500B/year, no duration bid from anyone in a crisis. Gold over bonds is still the structural trade.

excerpts.label: Brent at $100 — right on the precipice of demand destruction
excerpts.insight: SOFR curve pricing barely one cut. Brent closed above $100 today. The classic 2008 dynamic: oil spikes above $120, then absolute demand destruction and recession. We're right at that threshold.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: STEEPENERS. Front-end anchored by fiscal floor (5.5% deficit). Long-end has no bid — fiscal gridlock + basis trade hedge funds = bonds are a risk asset, not a safe haven. Buy front-end, sell long-end.

excerpts.label: Agricultural commodities — the sleeper trade nobody is watching
excerpts.insight: US farm bankruptcies +40% YoY. Farmers losing money handover fist. Supply compression cycle underway. Spring planting season is the irreversible catalyst — fertilizer ships through Hormuz.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: BUY wheat (ZW), corn (ZC), soybeans (ZS). Futures still net SHORT these. Spring planting disruption can't be reversed mid-year — 12-month crop shortfall if unresolved by July. Russia-Ukraine analogue: 50-300% in months.

excerpts.label: Where is Trump's uncle? Iran knows his stop loss
excerpts.insight: Iran has publicly stated they will push oil to $200 — they know that's Trump's liquidation level. Every tool has been used; SPR near floor, oil still above $100. This is 'uncle' not 'taco.'
excerpts.pm_takeaway: TAIL RISK: oil at $150-200 is Iran's explicit target. If realized, equities -30-40%, emergency Fed cut, dollar paradox. Size positions for this tail. This is not a 1% probability event.

excerpts.label: Private credit gated — the hidden tinder
excerpts.insight: Every major private credit fund has gated — no redemptions. AI data center buildout funded by Gulf sovereign wealth funds is drying up. Helium ships via Hormuz. Second and third-order effects just starting to show.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: AVOID private credit exposure and any equity dependent on Gulf SWF capex. Nvidia had 10 chances to be sold above $190 in 3 months. AI capex cycle is pausing — people won't care about AI when they can't fill their gas tank.
